test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B can do a piece of work in 9 days and 12 days, respectively. A starts the work and they work on alternate days. They can finish the work in:
solution:
**Given:**

Number of days taken by A to complete the work = 9 days

Number of days taken by B to complete the work = 12 days

Started the work alternately, with the start of work from A.

**Calculation:**

Total amount of work = LCM of 9 and 12

⇒ Total amount of work = 3 × 3 × 4 = 36 units

⇒ Work done by A per day = (36)/(9) = 4 units

⇒ Work done by B per day = (36)/(12) = 3 units

Starting the work alternatively with A,

First day work = 4 units

Second day work = 3 units and so on...

After 10 days, Total amount of work done = 4 × 5 + 3 × 5 = 35 units

Unit of work left = 1 unit

On the 11th day, A will work,

So, Time taken by A to complete 1 unit = (1)/(4)

Total work finished in working alternatively = 10(1)/(4) days

**Therefore, working alternately starting with A, the work will be finished in 10(1)/(4) days.**
